name: @pi-in-go/pigpen-hardening
description: Shared Go library for the opt-in enterprise profile of Pigpen Packages: profile loading, per-request credential files, an allow-listed egress transport, closed-field audit events, headless helpers, a fail-closed policy Decider (Cedar in a nested module) and JWT resource-server verification. Libraries only, no extension of its own.
author: Michael Kinsy
